text:
{faith:earth}管结构、秩序、体积与空间，信徒不多。信力看的是中体积及以上的道具出手，每场有上限；还看踩点，头一回踩上岔路给得多，再踩任何用过的点也给一点。献祭只收大块的东西，换的信力还要乘格子数。大地之神赐福中体积以上的道具，赐福版激活即加耐力上限。

一阶起开战的耐力上限更高；二阶在神坛上锻炼，棋盘每次加一行、不限次；三阶头一回踩上一个点就得到一件对应类型的道具，到{zone:地上}：战斗给武器、精英给防具、事件给饰物或素材、核心给贵重品；四阶在神坛上把当前点改造成别的类型，不限次。大地的护符本身是一只一格的空心石匣，能装一件小东西。

texts.en:
{faith:earth} governs structure, order, volume and space, and has few followers. Faith points come from medium-size or larger items activating, capped per battle, and from stepping onto spots: stepping onto a Fork for the first time gives a lot, and stepping onto any spot you've already used gives a little. This god accepts only large items as Offerings, and the Faith points they give are multiplied by their cell count. The God of the Earth blesses medium-size and larger items: a Blessed version raises max Stamina on activation.

From Rank one, you start battles with higher max Stamina. At Rank two you can train at an Altar to add one row to the Board each time, with no limit. At Rank three, the first time you step onto a spot you receive an item matching its type, placed on the {zone:地上}: battles give weapons, elites give armor, events give trinkets or materials, and the Core gives valuables. At Rank four you can reshape the current spot into a different type at an Altar, with no limit. The Earth's Charm is itself a hollow one-cell stone box that can hold one small item.
